row.notes: Whole body read. Clears out_list count (+0xa8), then walks 21 slots at owner+0x9f8..+0xb48 (16 bytes each, object pointer at +8). For each non-NULL slot it derives the local entrant id: via slot+0x28 -> +0x1e0 -> +0x88 -> +0x260, fetches the local identity block from g_Game_Manager (+0x140 -> +0x198 -> +0x1c0 vt+0x38), finds the matching EntrantRecord in +0x2e0..+0x2e8 with Sess_Match_EntrantIdentity_Thunk and packs its id bytes (default 0x3fff0000); then 0x1429bd780(slot, id) returns a 2-byte record. Slot is kept when byte0 != 0 and (mode 1: byte1 == 0; mode 0: byte1 != 0; other modes: no byte1 test); kept slot pointers are appended to out_list[0..] and the count stored at +0xa8. Returns out_list. Meaning of the two record bytes is not shown here.
